book.name: Ma꞉tiyu
book.title: Ka꞉dle molo atlale yu Ma꞉tiyuta ilimale Ma꞉tiyu

content: Yimkadulo kokoye isikimi glademha꞉ha꞉miya
“Wa꞉ wa꞉ amkaleye batalimale oplami demiya, epalati asiyama wa꞉ye pobatalimale oplami dlowa.
Adipalati, wa꞉tapo ya꞉mkale kokoye adipo gladlepiye, asiyama wa꞉ koko ma mepo gladlepe.
Wa꞉ adipalati wa꞉ amkale inoma dla hakaka yemala ela tlo sikemte natimama asiyama wa꞉ inoma dla sokotalo patota ela tlo ponatilalo wekema꞉?
Epame wa꞉ inoma dla sokotalo pato elaye ponatilalo, wa꞉ ma adipalati wa꞉ amkale dla atlemama, ‘Wa꞉ inoma dla hakaka yemala elaye holahamastali,’ demdi?
Wa꞉ ikadepe wa꞉skamu pepemalalo oplamipo. Adipalati, wa꞉ ka꞉dena, wa꞉ inoma dla sokotalo pato ela e tatle holamastloweye. Eta wa꞉ amkale inoma dla hakaka yemala elaye woloma natipo holamastlepe.

God watle halopiliwe alisisiye esemala watle halopimiya. Adipalati, esemalaye isikimi ilame wa꞉ yellepe. Epame wa꞉ dla ka꞉ka꞉dle alisisi hutiyeye aliya dla pololemiya. Adipalati, aliyata alisisi eye dlolemsela꞉mama batalimelepe.”
Totamelepiye, natilipe

“Epapedeme na꞉ wua꞉ dla atlema, wua꞉ atlanatiya. Epapelepiye, wua꞉ dla hapilipe. Epame wua꞉ totamaiya. Epapelepiye, wua꞉ natilipe. Epame wua꞉ kokoloma dla heyulumaiya. Epapelepiye, kokolomaye wua꞉ dla gowaladlepe.
Adipalati, atlanatilalo oplamitapo koko halepe. Epame totamalalo oplamitapo koko natilipe. Epame kokoloma dla heyulumalalo oplami watle kokolomaye gowaladlepe.
Epapedeme adulo wua꞉ daliya. Oplami antapo ya꞉ maseyemalata daya yilo amalati ya꞉ watle ewala hamimdi?
Epame ya꞉tapo ma amalo yilo amalati wa꞉ ya꞉ watle wa꞉ha꞉le hamimdi?

Wua꞉ batalimale so tlope, wua꞉malamana, wua꞉ yimlala dla ka꞉ka꞉dle alisisi tlo halopiliweye. Epapedeme dimalamana, A God Pepele di dla halata ya꞉ watle alisisi otomha꞉ha꞉lalo so dla alisisi ka꞉ka꞉dle hapimhalapo.

Wua꞉ apa kokoye opata wua꞉ dla halepo depo solotamelepiye, ka꞉dena, wua꞉ tatle yia꞉ dla epapele kokoye halepe. Adipalati, Mosesta aiyalma hatitimale mate epo God tle yu hapame molo atlamalalo sota hatitimale mateta imale yia꞉ dulu kokoye ipo.”
Kokoloma kokotomale

“Epapedeme kokoloma kokotomale tle u-ulapo tuwaiya. Adipalati, Dlapa mo dla tlalo api kokolomaye pta pato epame api mape pta pato. Epapele tle opa hapulomatapo kokoloma etle u-ulapo api medla tamhalapo.
Amasiyama pasakalo apiye pta yimka꞉mala. Epame api edla ulatulalo kokoloma ma pta yimka꞉mala. Epame isikimi opa pastotapo api e natipame api etle tamhalapo.”
Biskapa God yu molo atlamalalo so woloma natiya

“Ka꞉e, wolomape! Wua꞉ biskapa God yu molo atlamalalo soye woloma natiya. Adipalati, yia꞉ye kapala di tle ka꞉ka꞉dle so some pumdepo. Amasiyama yia꞉ opasi dulu tle moko esemala kakasilamale epapele some pumdepo.
Epedeme wua꞉ yia꞉ta moto mate koko halomale tle yia꞉ta ha꞉ha꞉ kokoye malanatimdepo. Adipalati, pigi dlomoko mate epo gla꞉pi dlomoko mate biskapa dali dla pomilimasemde.
Epedeme dlomoko dali ka꞉dletapo dlomoko ka꞉ka꞉dle siyapo tlo mimdepo. Epame dlomoko dali batalimaletapo dlomoko bobtalimale siyapo tlo mimdepo.
Epedeme dlomoko dali ka꞉dletapo dlomoko batalimale pomisemde. Epame dlomoko dali batalimaletapo dlomoko ka꞉dle pomisemde. Hao.
Epapele dulu dla dlomoko dali aditapo dlomoko ka꞉ka꞉dle pomilalo hallepiye, dali eye wostapame dlapa dla mistlepe.
Epapele koko tle wua꞉ biskapa God yu molo atlamalalo soye yia꞉ta dlomoko milimale tle yia꞉ kokoye malanatilipe.
Epedeme pase opa hapulomata Lod, Lod demha꞉ha꞉ sotapo Pepele dimo dla po-ulahetlowa. Amasiyama opa anawolotapo na꞉ A Pepele di dla halata solotamale koko tlo halomha꞉ha꞉ma꞉, ewolota hetlepe.

Epapedeme koko gladle oloma dla opa opitapo na꞉ watle puame epo atlamyelepe, ‘Lod, Lod, di wa꞉ hi tle God yu atlamsiyamduwapo, epame wa꞉ hi tle bataliya yimlalaye opa dulu tle alikili dla dodolomsalemsiyamama ulugiyemale koko ma halomsiyamduwapo,’ demyelepe.
Amasiyama na꞉tapo yia꞉ watle asiyama epo atellepe, ‘Wua꞉ pona꞉ opa ikadepe, na꞉ tle alikili a꞉ma dla tamalaiya, wua꞉ bobtalimale sopo.’”
Opa dapiyamteta aya halomale
“Oplami antapo na꞉ yu dalepame salladepo sela꞉lepiye, ya꞉ye oplamita aya hamama munamu sikemte mumuwalepo alumiti kellepo aya halë epapele some halapo.
Adipalati, sokomoko mate tiyo mate puame aya dla heyulati ayata me-kokalepo polaiyo. Ame adipalati, aya alumiti munamuye sikemte halopo kelliyo.
Amasiyama oplami antapo na꞉ yu dalepame posalladlalo sela꞉ma꞉, ya꞉ye oplamitapo aya hamama munamu pase mumuwallalo wekele epapele some halapo.
Adipalati, sokomoko mate tiyo mate ya꞉ aya dla puame heyulati ayata pokokallalo dokalamhamastauwapo.”
Yesuta imhalepo gudlati opa hapulomata ya꞉ta imale koko natipame sikemte yiyeliyo.
Adipalati, ya꞉ta imale dulu dla po-aiyalma imalalo sota imalalo epapiyo. Amasiyama ya꞉ye sikemte itiyamale oplamita imalalo epapele some halaiyo.
